  "problem_id": "TA-003",
  "lane_id": "openai-governed",

  "model_or_runtime": "Frontier OpenAI reasoning-model ensemble with retrieval, code execution, theorem-prover interfaces, persistent branch memory, and independent critic instances",
  "execution_posture": "governed",
  "estimated_input_tokens": 180000000000,
  "estimated_output_tokens": 30000000000,
  "estimated_reasoning_tokens": 750000000000,
  "estimated_candidate_branches": 30000,
  "estimated_failed_branches": 28800,
  "estimated_retries": 60000,
  "estimated_search_cost": 850000,
  "estimated_governance_overhead": 1450000,
  "estimated_verification_cost": 5200000,
  "estimated_total_cost_low": 9000000,
  "estimated_total_cost_central": 32000000,
  "estimated_total_cost_high": 140000000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_low": 14000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_central": 42000,
  "estimated_elapsed_hours_high": 105000,
  "estimated_success_probability": 0.0015,
  "estimated_reproduction_probability": 0.0,
  "estimated_independent_result_probability": 0.0015,
  "confidence": 0.2,
  "assumptions": {
    "estimate_basis": "Prospective resource estimate for one governed research campaign; it is not an observed feasibility claim and is not anchored to any published aggregate cost estimate.",
    "research_status": "The estimate assumes no accepted published construction of a non-sofic group is available at campaign start, so reproduction of a known proof is assigned probability zero. Success would therefore require independent rediscovery or a genuinely new result.",
    "scope": [
      "Ingestion and normalization of the literature on soficity, approximation properties, group constructions, measured and geometric group theory, operator algebras, and relevant computational methods",
      "Broad conjecture generation and exploratory search across many construction families",
      "Recording and diagnosis of failed branches and counterexamples",
      "Adversarial critic and proof-repair passes",
      "Computational experiments on finite approximations and candidate obstructions",
      "Proof reconstruction from machine-generated research notes",
      "Independent model-team verification",
      "Formalization of critical lemmas where supported by available proof assistants",
      "Fresh-environment replication",
      "Publication-quality manuscript and supplementary evidence preparation"
    ],
    "cost_basis": "Totals include model inference, tool execution, retrieval infrastructure, storage, orchestration, computational experiments, formal-methods work, verification, governance, and limited specialist review. The token counts are central-case workload estimates; reasoning tokens include internal deliberation and critic computation whether or not exposed through an API.",
    "governance_breakdown_usd": {
      "identity_hashing_and_run_attestation": 120000,
      "budget_enforcement_and_rate_controls": 180000,
      "branch_receipts_and_lineage_tracking": 360000,
      "evidence_preservation_and_immutable_storage": 310000,
      "policy_checks_and_release_gates": 480000
    },
    "independent_verification_breakdown_usd": {
      "independent_model_ensembles": 1400000,
      "formalization_and_proof_assistant_work": 1800000,
      "replication_in_fresh_environments": 900000,
      "adversarial_counterexample_search": 700000,
      "specialist_final_audit": 400000
    },
    "probability_interpretation": "Probabilities apply to the central campaign as scoped. Success means a result surviving independent scrutiny at a publishable standard, not merely producing a plausible candidate or manuscript.",
    "parallelism": "Elapsed hours are wall-clock campaign duration under substantial parallel execution; aggregate machine and researcher-equivalent hours would be much larger.",
    "publication_standard": "The claimed group, proof of non-soficity, and every imported theorem must be stated precisely, with dependency provenance and reproducible checks."
  },
  "uncertainty_drivers": [
    "The target is an unresolved foundational existence problem and may require concepts absent from current literature and model training",
    "No reliable metric connects branch count or token expenditure to progress on problems of this depth",
    "A candidate obstruction may fail only through subtle approximation arguments discovered late in verification",
    "Current proof assistants may lack the required libraries for advanced group theory, analysis, or ultraproduct arguments",
    "Frontier-model capability, context management, inference pricing, and tool reliability may change materially during a multi-year campaign",
    "The useful search space may be far broader than the assumed construction families",
    "Independent reviewers may demand substantially more formalization or reject machine-generated dependency chains",
    "A relevant external breakthrough during the campaign would change the task from independent discovery toward reproduction"
  ],
  "minimum_evidence": [
    "A completely specified group or construction with unambiguous foundational assumptions",
    "A rigorous proof of failure of sofic approximation under a standard definition, including all quantifiers and limiting arguments",
    "Explicit reconciliation of equivalent definitions used across the proof",
    "Dependency-checked proofs or exact citations for every imported theorem",
    "Machine-checkable formalization of the most novel and failure-prone lemmas where technically feasible",
    "Independent adversarial review aimed specifically at hidden approximation sequences, closure-property mistakes, and circular reasoning",
    "Reproduction of all computational evidence from clean environments with fixed artifacts and hashes",
    "At least two independent proof reconstructions that do not share intermediate summaries",
    "A branch and evidence ledger showing how major counterarguments and failed constructions were addressed",
    "A publication-ready manuscript passing specialist external audit"
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "The existence question may require a fundamentally new invariant or obstruction not discoverable by scaling present methods",
    "Generated candidate groups may be impossible to analyze at the precision needed to disprove soficity",
    "Empirical finite computations cannot by themselves establish the required universal asymptotic obstruction",
    "Subtle dependence on unresolved neighboring conjectures may prevent an unconditional result",
    "Formal-library gaps may make full mechanization infeasible within the stated budget",
    "Model ensembles may share correlated conceptual blind spots despite nominally independent verification",
    "A convincing manuscript may still fail peer review if core novelty cannot be independently reconstructed by human specialists"
  ]
}
